CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_match_risk_profile(p_match_id text)
RETURNS jsonb AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        SELECT jsonb_build_object(
            'Immun_Risk', rm->>'Immun_Risk',
            'Infect_Risk', rm->>'Infect_Risk',
            'Reject_Risk', rm->>'Reject_Risk',
            'Readmit_Risk', rm->>'Readmit_Risk',
            'Mort_Risk', rm->>'Mort_Risk'
        )
        FROM risk_evaluation r
        JOIN jsonb_each_text(r.riskmetrics) AS j(key, val)
          ON TRUE
        WHERE r.risk_eval_registry = p_match_id
        GROUP BY r.riskmetrics
    );
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
